'''2019 Worlds Day 2 Robert Smolarek DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Robert Smolarek]] at [[2019 World Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Robert Smolarek]]
* '''Event:''' [[2019 World Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|SE-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open HD Smolarek DS 2019 Worlds.txt |Download]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2019-worlds/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210127130309/https://www.starwarsccg.org/2019-worlds/ Internet Archive]
